purpose: Express a strong personal feeling at the present situation.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
い-adjective / な-adjective + な + 限りだ
Your kind words make me extremely happy.
It is deeply disappointing that the exhibition is canceled.
With nobody to consult, I feel terribly alone.
formation: い-adjective / な-adjective + な + 限りだ
restrictions: Most natural with feelings such as うれしい, 残念, 心細い.
mistake: Do not use it indiscriminately with objective physical properties.
